Write the code for the following words using the conditions given below :
(i)
If any code ends with ‘0’ change ‘0’ to 9
(ii) If no match is found use X
(iii) If the first digit is ‘0’ replace it by 1
(iv) If both the first and last digits are equal numbers, $ 0 and $ 2, then change the first
digit to 2
